title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ(長田茂美研究室)
subtitle: Design Project III (Nagata Shigemi)
educationalGoal: In this course, based on the concrete knowledge of fundamental technologies, students acquire problem-solving skills related to computer & information engineering. Students are also given opportunities to experience R&D activities related to concrete information technology and systems. Through this process, students cultivate advanced abilities in the areas of problem-setting, production process development, information gathering, communications, problem-solving in regional orientation, and conducting objective evaluations.
advice: In this course, students are required to learn and practice R&D methods in the following areas of activity: 1. Computer & Network System Area: - Fundamental technologies such as signal processing, image processing, numerical processing, etc., based on mathematical structures, logical structures, and the physical structures of information and information systems. - Application systems using these technologies. 2. Information & Software System Area: - Fundamental technologies such as artificial intelligence, deep learning, knowledge processing, agent systems, WWW search, and so on. - Intelligent systems and multimedia search/mining systems using these technologies. 3. Cybermedia Information System Area: - Fundamental technologies such as machine learning, deep learning, pattern recognition and understanding, image processing, video processing, augmented reality, and so on. - Application systems using these technologies.
books: Textbooks: None Reference books: None Reserved books: None
requiredKnowledge: Accumulation of results is extremely important. Students are expected to be sure to conduct self-checks at every milestone, such as progress reports for each semester and interim presentations.

activityGoals.body: Be able to set one-year achievement goals in relation to your chosen research.
Be able to set a specific production approach based on your set research concept.
Be able to use your acquired information engineering expertise to advance your design and analysis efforts.
Be able to cope with various problems that occur during the design and analysis process.
Be able to technically describe what you have accomplished in a convincing manner.

achievementLevels.ideal: Be able to promote R&D activities smoothly according to the project plan (proposal) that you have created. In the results, it is desirable that students be able to announce concrete results that are scientifically or technically recognized as novel, effective, and reliable.
achievementLevels.standard: Be able to promote R&D activities smoothly according to the project plan (proposal) that you have created. In the results, it is desirable that students be able to announce results that are based in scientific or technical reality.
